description: The file defines the SiloControl class in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, responsible for managing silo operations such as statistics collection, control commands, and grain management within an Orleans silo environment.

classes.name: SiloControl
classes.description: Handles control operations for an Orleans silo, such as system metrics, grain management, control commands, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Responds to a ping message, used for health checks.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Forces a garbage collection on the silo to reclaim memory.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Triggers collection of activations older than a specified age limit.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves current runtime statistics of the silo, including activation count and environment stats.

methods.name: GetGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics of grains within the silo, grouped by grain type.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Provides detailed statistics for grains, optionally filtered by types.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Provides simplified grain statistics as an array.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainReport
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific grain, including address and lifecycle info.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of activations in the silo.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a specified provider identified by name.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for grain interface versions.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Lists active grains of a specific grain type.

methods.name: MigrateRandomActivations
methods.description: Migrates a number of activations to a target silo.
